name: Shipping Label

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler in the southern territories, you can help the Azeroth Commerce Authority recover stray cargo and secure overland transport routes from its hub at Three Corners.

faq.answer: The Shipping Label is a damaged freight marker attached to a supply crate owned by the Azeroth Commerce Authority. The recipient's name is missing, but the label directs whoever finds the crate to report to the authority's hub at Three Corners.

aliases: what is the azeroth commerce authority
faq.answer: The Azeroth Commerce Authority organizes logistics, trade, and freight across the region. It keeps local trade hubs to recover lost shipments and employs roving couriers without long-term contracts.
faq.q: What is the Azeroth Commerce Authority?

aliases: where to turn in shipping label
faq.answer: The Azeroth Commerce Authority's trade hub is at the Three Corners crossroads in the Redridge Mountains, along the roads linking Elwynn Forest, Duskwood, and Lakeshire.
faq.q: Where is the Azeroth Commerce Authority trade hub located?

faq.answer: Merchant's Favor is scrip or credit the Azeroth Commerce Authority grants to independent couriers. Affiliates can use it to buy trade goods and logistical services at the authority's posts.

To become an affiliate, you need no formal contract, paperwork, or long-term commitment. The Azeroth Commerce Authority asks couriers to help return or complete misplaced deliveries they encounter on the road.
faq.q: How do you become an affiliate of the Azeroth Commerce Authority?

faq.answer: After you deliver the label, representatives at the trade hub ask about the crate it came from. Returning empty or fulfilled shipping containers remains vital to their trade operations.
faq.q: What happens to the crate after delivering the label?

sections.body: A damaged label marks a stocked supply crate as freight belonging to the Azeroth Commerce Authority. The destination and recipient have been torn away, but the label tells anyone who finds the cargo to return it or report to the authority's trade outpost in the Redridge Mountains. Beside the formal text, a rough map sketches the roads toward the Three Corners intersection.
sections.title: A Stray Delivery

sections.body: At Three Corners, representatives of the Azeroth Commerce Authority enlist travelers as independent couriers. The authority does not bind haulers to strict merchant contracts. Instead, it runs an informal network that compensates them with Merchant's Favor for recovering missing cargo and completing abandoned deliveries along the highway.
sections.title: The Commerce Authority's Hub

summary: A damaged Shipping Label points toward the Azeroth Commerce Authority's trade hub at Three Corners in the Redridge Mountains. It marks a supply crate as the authority's property and shows travelers where to report it.
